# Comic Motion Studio third-party components

The following browser-side components are bundled for local/offline use by Comic Motion Studio:

- JSZip 3.10.1 — ZIP/CBZ import and `.hhcomic` packaging — MIT or GPL-3.0-or-later; this project uses it under MIT. Source: https://github.com/Stuk/jszip/tree/v3.10.1
- PDF.js distribution 4.10.38 — PDF page rendering — Apache-2.0. Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/tree/v4.10.38
- Tesseract.js 6.0.1 and Tesseract core 6.0.0 — on-device OCR — Apache-2.0. Sources: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js/tree/v6.0.1 and https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
- Tesseract fast `vie` and `eng` trained data — OCR language data — Apache-2.0. Source: https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast

Corresponding license texts are stored in `vendor/licenses/`.

These software licenses do not grant rights to any comic, image, voice, music, website, or other user-provided media processed by the application. Rights for imported media are recorded separately in each Comic Motion Studio project/source manifest.
